description: The march from France through Germany to Schengen in Luxembourg demonstrated against the newly introduced border controls at Europe's internal borders.The march, supported by a broad coalition of parties and civil society (Volt, associations of Young European Federalists (JEF), the European Movement, the Europa-Union, Pulse of Europe, the Rhineland-Palatinate Pirate Party and PdH), emphasises the broad commitment to maintaining a borderless Europe that prioritises unity, cooperation and freedom.
